article.title: Causado con 에게/을를
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide’s **-게 하다** section documents target arguments marked with **이/가**, **을/를**, or **에게/한테** in its examples. This entry is restricted to the attested alternation; the source does not support a universal rule predicting a marker without regard to predicate and context.
